title: Budgeting for Clean Air: A Financial Essential for Indian Households
description: Poor air quality is increasingly making air purifiers a necessary household expense in many Indian cities. When purchasing, prioritise an air purifier's effec.

faq.q: Are air purifiers tax deductible in India?
faq.a: Generally, the cost of an air purifier is not directly tax-deductible under Section 80D of the Income Tax Act, as it is considered a household appliance rather than a medical expense. However, medical expenses incurred due to pollution-related illnesses might be covered under health insurance, which can offer tax benefits on premiums.

faq.q: How often should I replace air purifier filters?
faq.a: Filter replacement frequency depends on the specific model, local air quality, and usage. Typically, HEPA filters need changing every 6-12 months, while activated carbon filters might last 3-6 months. Always refer to your purifier's user manual for precise recommendations.

faq.q: What is CADR and why is it important?
faq.a: CADR stands for Clean Air Delivery Rate. It measures how quickly an air purifier removes pollutants like smoke, dust, and pollen from a room. A higher CADR indicates faster and more effective air cleaning for a larger area, making it a critical factor in choosing the right purifier for your room size.

faq.q: Can I save money by cleaning filters instead of replacing them?
faq.a: While some pre-filters can be cleaned and reused, HEPA and activated carbon filters are designed for trapping pollutants and cannot be effectively cleaned. Attempting to wash or vacuum these filters can damage their structure and reduce their purification efficiency, making replacement necessary.

faq.q: Should I buy multiple air purifiers for different rooms?
faq.a: For optimal air quality throughout your home, it is often recommended to have an air purifier in each frequently used room, such as bedrooms and the living area. Moving a single purifier between rooms is less effective as it takes time to clean the air in each space.
